description.narrative: The project aims to enhance the employability and economic empowerment of women and girls in remote regions of Uzbekistan by expanding their access to quality STEM education and entrepreneurship opportunities. It focuses on building foundational and advanced STEM skills among high school students, university students, and recent graduates through structured training, mentorship, and practical learning experiences. The initiative also supports women-led startups by providing tailored acceleration programs, mentorship, and seed funding to foster innovation and business growth. A two-week Summer Boot Camp will bring together top-performing participants for intensive workshops, networking, and a showcase of innovative solutions. Activities are implemented through regional Digital Education Development Centers to ensure accessibility and local engagement. By addressing gender disparities in STEM and entrepreneurship, the project contributes to inclusive development, supports national digital transformation goals, and promotes a more equitable and knowledge-driven economy.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
